Mount Pleasant Golf Club

Est. 1910 · Lowell, Massachusetts

The Course →

Welcome to Mount Pleasant Golf Club, a private nine-hole club in Lowell, Massachusetts, established in 1910. Tucked away in a moderately dense residential area in the Highlands section of Lowell. Founded by neighbors to promote social interaction, exercise, tennis, golf and athletic sports.

Our course.

Nine holes.

Membership types

  • Regular A Membership: 275 members, no playing restrictions, only votes in club matters
  • Limited B Membership: 50 members, playing restrictions during league play, tournaments, weekend mornings
  • Junior & Youth Membership totals 50 members; Junior Members (18-24) have no playing restrictions but no vote
  • Family Membership includes kids under 18 and a spouse
  • Student discounts available for Juniors in school

History

Founded by neighbors to promote social interaction, exercise, tennis, golf and athletic sports.

Name taken from The Mount Pleasant Realty Company; original nine holes on Stedman and Westford Streets.

Only two clubhouses in club's history; current clubhouse footprint established in 1922, most recently renovated in 2003.

Most recent renovation in 2003 modernized members' grill, locker rooms, proshop and function hall.

House rules

  • All beverages must be purchased through Mount Pleasant Golf Club
  • Confetti may not be used as decoration
  • Police detail required for birthday parties ages 16-21 with 7-day notice
